run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th digit from the right of a raised to the power of b
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes a**b and extracts the k-th digit from the right
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for digit extraction
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases where k exceeds the number of digits in a**b
